title: P-006 / AUTO-BAR-R-10-P-006 — current-cohort targeted L4 tool-turn-correlation mutation proof

spec.behavior: The installed first-message journey succeeds independently on Claude, Codex and OMP.
spec.falsifier: Any supported engine needs its native interface or fails the composer-to-reply journey.
spec.whyL4: The plan-class feature-ship adequacy evaluation requires a falsifiable current-cohort proof beyond the passing end-to-end journey. This targeted mutation demonstrates that R-10's same-turn tool-result oracle becomes red when the asserted property is broken.

currentCohort.note: The evidence binding server measures these exact file sets. No caller-computed fingerprint is used.

mutation.semanticChange: Tool completion loses correlation with the owner turn that started the real file-tool call.

sites.before: else emit({ type: 'tool', phase: 'completed', turnId: ownerTurnId, callId, name, output: frame.result as SuSessionJsonValue, isError: frame.isError === true });
sites.after: else emit({ type: 'tool', phase: 'completed', turnId: 'mutant-turn', callId, name, output: frame.result as SuSessionJsonValue, isError: frame.isError === true });

sites.before: this.host.emit({ type: 'tool', phase: 'completed', turnId, callId, name, output: asJsonValue(entry.text ?? ''), isError } as SuSessionEventInput<'omp'>);
sites.after: this.host.emit({ type: 'tool', phase: 'completed', turnId: 'mutant-turn', callId, name, output: asJsonValue(entry.text ?? ''), isError } as SuSessionEventInput<'omp'>);

mutation.whyTwoSites: A real OMP tool completion can reach the host through the live RPC-frame path or transcript-snapshot replay. Mutating only one site can be masked by the other, so the probe applies one semantic break at both live completion emitters.
mutation.deadCodeTrapAvoided: The visually similar Codex-only RPC branch is not live on the OMP route. The probe mutates the OMP fall-through emitter at the branch established from the current call graph, rather than a dead site that could create a false survived verdict.
mutation.targetOracle: expect(readEnd, 'the real tool result must return in the same turn').toMatchObject({ turnId: readStart?.turnId })

probe.mode: tier-3 in-tree with a two-path sweep-exclusion file lock
probe.command: PAPERCUSP_TEST_RUN_HARNESS=papercusp PAPERCUSP_WORKSPACE_ID=papercusp-workspace PUI_REAL_ENGINE=1 PUI_BIN=$HOME/.cargo/bin/pui PUI_REAL_BACKEND=omp PUI_REAL_ACCOUNT=auto PUI_NATIVE_ACCOUNT_CATALOG="$REPO/.papercusp/scratch/p006/account-catalog.json" npm run test:file -- packages/operator-core/lib/pui-e2e/agent-chat-pty.integration.test.ts -t 'greeting, real file tool, interrupt and continued reply stay in one first-party session'
probe.replayCommand: PAPERCUSP_TEST_RUN_HARNESS=papercusp PAPERCUSP_WORKSPACE_ID=papercusp-workspace PUI_REAL_ENGINE=1 PUI_BIN=$HOME/.cargo/bin/pui PUI_REAL_BACKEND=omp PUI_REAL_ACCOUNT=auto PUI_NATIVE_ACCOUNT_CATALOG="$REPO/docs/evidence/pui-p006-account-catalog.json" npm run test:file -- packages/operator-core/lib/pui-e2e/agent-chat-pty.integration.test.ts -t 'greeting, real file tool, interrupt and continued reply stay in one first-party session'

accountCatalog.equivalence: The two catalogs contain the identical sorted set of ten {id, provider} records, which is the metadata consumed by this fixture; the durable copy carries additional explanatory metadata.

probe.modelPin: Intentionally omitted for OMP account=auto under plan Decision D-013; this backend refuses an incompatible model pin instead of silently substituting it.
launchGuards: The wrapper required the named selector to request, execute and match exactly one collected test.
The secondary guard required exactly one current source occurrence before applying its mutation.
A caught verdict required the mutant to fail at the exact same-turn correlation assertion, not merely exit nonzero.

result.meaning: The current installed-PUI R-10 journey is falsifiable for same-turn tool-result correlation: correct current source passes, while the same test fails on its direct semantic oracle when both live OMP completion routes lose their turn id.

restoreProof.method: Both tracked sources were compared byte-for-byte by SHA-256 with values captured before the mutation, and the wrapper independently reported tree integrity for the primary source.

postProbeCleanRun.removedFailureAbsent: The exact `[bounded-timeout] declare-intent:prev-intent` warning from the rejected attempt does not occur in the clean run log.

rejectedAttempt.reason: The otherwise-unmutated journey failed only because a redundant pre-upsert previous-intent lookup exceeded its 1500ms advisory bound and vitest-fail-on-console rejected the warning. HEAD also moved during that attempt, so its provenance was unknown independently.

engineScope.caveat: This mutation proves sensitivity of the shared installed-PUI R-10 journey on OMP. It does not fill the separately required per-engine Claude and Codex coverage, so P-006 must remain open after an adequacy pass.

rawLogs.durability: The log and secondary guard are gitignored transient scratch. Every load-bearing result line, source delta, assertion, file set, catalog equivalence, and restore hash is copied into this tracked artifact.

adequacy.scopeCaveat: This is a test-adequacy verdict for the exact OMP references, not the spec's required cross-engine parity verdict.
